artworks.title: Asclepias syriaca
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mary and Dan Solomon and Patrons' Permanent Fund
artworks.description: The image shows a cluster of small, star-shaped flowers with five distinct petals each, densely packed together. The color palette is monochromatic, utilizing shades of black, white, and gray. The flowers are centrally positioned in the frame, spreading outward in a circular pattern that encompasses much of the image.

artworks.title: Asclepias speciosa
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mary and Dan Solomon and Patrons' Permanent Fund
artworks.description: Small star-shaped flowers with elongated petals fill the image in a densely packed composition. The color palette consists of varying shades of gray. The flowers overlay and intertwine with each other, creating an intricate pattern that spans from top to bottom and from left to right, leaving no empty spaces.

artworks.title: Asclepias incarnata
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mary and Dan Solomon and Patrons' Permanent Fund
artworks.description: The image shows a circular layout of small flowers with many petals and leaves, forming a dense floral cluster. The color scheme is monochromatic, displayed in shades of gray as it is a black and white image. The flowers are centrally positioned, occupying most of the frame, with some petals and leaves extending outward towards the edges on a textured surface that contrasts gently with the floral arrangement.

artworks.title: Achillea filipendulina
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mary and Dan Solomon and Patrons' Permanent Fund
artworks.description: The image displays a series of rounded, swirling shapes covering the entire area in an intricate pattern. The composition evokes the look of a densely packed coral reef or a close-up of a textured surface like old, weathered rock. The repetitive nature of the shapes and their dense arrangement create a sense of movement and depth similar to cloud formations or clusters of bubbles. The interplay between the dark and light areas enhances the visual complexity of the image, giving it an almost organic quality.

artworks.title: Achillea clypeolata
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mary and Dan Solomon and Patrons' Permanent Fund
artworks.description: The image shows a cluster of small flowers with distinct petals and textured centers. The color palette is grayscale, with shades of black, white, and gray. The flowers densely cover the frame, creating a cohesive pattern.

artworks.title: Tellima grandiflora
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mary and Dan Solomon and Patrons' Permanent Fund
artworks.description: The image displays a detailed arrangement of sharp, spiky shapes interweaving throughout the composition. This abstract pattern resembles clusters of marine life, such as sea anemones or star-like coral formations. The lines and forms hint at a natural order, reminiscent of textures found in a biological or oceanic environment.

artworks.title: Emily Pollock and Terrisa "Ris" Nimsey
artworks.creditLine: Robert B. Menschel and the Vital Projects Fund
artworks.description: The image shows two people from the waist up. The person on the left is sitting slightly forward and is holding a large, thin, cylindrical object. They have short, dark hair and are wearing a high-necked, long-sleeved, checkered dress with white and dark checks. Their facial expression is neutral, with their eyes looking straight ahead. The person on the right is sitting close to the first person, with their hand resting on the side of their face, and they have light curly hair. They are wearing a dark garment with a light-colored collar. The background is dark.

artworks.title: Portrait of a Native American Woman
artworks.medium: albumen silver print with applied color (carte-de-visite)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Funds from Clinton and Jean Wright and Alfred H. Moses and Fern M. Schad Fund
artworks.description: The image features a standing person in colorful clothing with unique facial paint. They are near a decorative chair and have short dark hair. They are wearing jewelry and have a pointed ring on one hand. The setting includes a geometric tiled floor and textured walls in the background.

artworks.title: Louise de Lorraine, Queen of France
artworks.description: The image displays a portrait of a person from the chest up. The individual faces slightly to the right with a serious expression. Their features include a high forehead, thin eyebrows, and parted lips. They have a high, voluminous hairstyle and wear an elaborate high-collared ruff. The person wears pearl jewelry, including an earring and necklace. Their attire features intricate patterns and the background is plain, with the portrait enclosed in an oval border with inscriptions.

artworks.title: The Great Anxiety (Self-Portrait in Three-Quarter Profile to the Right) (Die große  Angst [Selbstportrat, Kopf im Halbprofil nach rechts])
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Christopher and Beverly With in memory of Karl and Gerda With
artworks.description: This print shows a stylized representation of a person with only their head and one hand prominently displayed. The face is slightly turned to the right, and it has exaggerated features, including large circular eyes with swirling pupils, a pointed nose, and a wide brow. It is painted in shades of bluish-green, with bright yellow-green highlights. Above the head are several sweeping lines and soft pastel colors such as purple, pink, and blue, perhaps indicating a hat. The hand is near the bottom left corner, and it is elongated, with twisted fingers reaching outward. The hand is painted in the same bluish-green hue. The background is a blend of pastel colors, mainly purple and pink tones, and some curved off-white sections below the head could suggest shoulders or a torso, crisscrossed with thin black lines.

artworks.title: Consecration et Action de Graces avant et après la Communion à Zurich; Communion dans l’Eglise du Fraumunster à Zurich (Consecration and Communion at the Fraumunster, Zurich)
artworks.description:
This is a drawing of two religious ceremonies taking place in a church setting. The first scene shows a group of figures gathered around a table filled with lit candlesticks. Some figures are positioned at the table while others kneel. The architecture suggests an interior of a church or cathedral. There are figures in the side sections as well, observing the event.

The second scene shows a larger assembly with individuals wearing distinctive headwear. The architectural style remains consistent with the first scene, featuring arched openings, a central altar, and additional figures throughout. Labels and annotations identify specific figures or activities within the scene, indicating an informative illustration of cultural or religious practices.

artworks.title: Procession des Bourgeois de la Tribu des Boulangers vers l’Eglise du Grossmunster à Zurich, pour y prêter le Serment; Acte Solemnel de prêter Serment au Magistrat dans l’eglise du Grossmunster à Zurich (Procession and Sermon at the Grossmunster)
artworks.description: This is a drawing showing a ceremonial procession in an urban setting. The top section shows a formal procession on a cobblestone street between ornate buildings. The bottom section portrays the interior of a grand architectural space with rows of people in formal attire. The setting suggests an organized event associated with governance or public office, set in a historical urban context.

artworks.title: Reception des Candidats dans le St. Ministere, à Zurich; Presentation et Ordination Solemnelle d’un Nouveau Pasteur dans une Eglise de la Campagne de Zurich (Reception of the Candidates and Presentation and Ordination of a New Pastor)
artworks.description:
This is a drawing of a formal gathering inside ecclesiastical and civic buildings. The image contains two panels that depict different scenes related to ecclesiastical ceremonies or events in Zurich. 

In the top panel, a group of figures is assembled inside a room with large windows and a tiled stove. The scene appears structured and ordered, with individuals standing on either side of a central figure. 

The bottom panel shows a formal ceremonial occasion inside a church, where figures in religious attire stand before a gathered assembly. The setting features arched windows, vaulted ceilings, and an elevated pulpit. A group of seated figures on either side of the aisle reflect a solemn congregation witnessing the proceedings. 

The style of the drawing captures architectural features and attire of the period, emphasizing the significance of these formal events.

artworks.title: Baptême du Juif Jachiel Hirschlin à Zurich. 1746; Distribution des Livres avec Etudians et aux Ecôliers à Zurich (Baptism of Jachiel Hirschlin and Distribution of the Books)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a baptism and a book distribution ceremony in Zurich. The drawing is divided into two sections, each depicting a distinct event. The upper section shows a baptism taking place in a church setting. An ornate baptismal font is centered in the scene, with religious figures in robes conducting the ceremony, surrounded by an audience of onlookers and participants dressed in period attire. The architectural features, such as tall windows and vaulted arches, contribute to the solemnity of the chapel interior. A small dog can be observed in the foreground. The lower section illustrates a book distribution ceremony. A higher platform holds individuals engaged in the distribution, with a large group of attendees seated and observing the proceedings. This section also features intricate detailing of the church's interior architecture, including wooden panels and decorative stonework.

artworks.title: Costumes of Churchgoers of the Reformed Church
artworks.description: The image consists of an illustration featuring multiple figures dressed in historical attire. In the top row, three women wear full-length dresses with ornate bonnets, while the bottom row shows three men wearing coats and hats. Each figure is depicted with specific details in their clothing, emphasizing the historical or cultural significance.

artworks.title: Costumes of the Men of the Reformed Church
artworks.description: The image consists of six full-body portraits of men wearing attire from the 17th or 18th century. They are standing upright in formal postures, each with distinct facial features. The men's clothing includes long cloaks, knee-length coats, knee breeches, stockings, and buckled shoes. Some wear high-collared ruffs, wigs, or natural curls. One man holds a staff, and another wears a tricorn hat. Additional accessories such as hats and gloves are also visible. The background is plain.

artworks.title: Catafalque for Ranuccio II in the Church of the Steccata
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a baroque architectural structure with ornate decorative elements. The image features a highly detailed and symmetrical altar-like structure, set upon a series of stepped platforms. The central focus is a tall spiral column adorned with decorative ribbons and topped with a small domed canopy with a cross. Flanking the central column are two smaller triangular forms equipped with lamps or candelabras. Intricate scrolls, carvings, and classical motifs enrich the surface. Raised urns emitting flames are placed at strategic points for balance and emphasis.

artworks.title: Catafalque in the Cathedral of Piacenza for Odoardo Farnese, Duke of Parma and Piacenza
artworks.artist: Giovanni Noati, after Cristoforo Rangoni, called Ficarelli
artworks.dimensions: sheet: 52.7 × 39 cm (20 3/4 × 15 3/8 in.) trimmed within plate mark
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an elaborate architectural structure. The drawing depicts a highly intricate and ornate architectural piece. The structure is tiered and rises to a pointed apex, combining classical design elements such as arches and balustrades. The symmetry and detailed craftsmanship suggest an impressive and ceremonial purpose.

artworks.title: Plan, Elevation and Section of the Funeral Monument to the Cardinal of Bouillon
artworks.description: This is a detailed illustration of an ornate architectural altar design in Baroque style. The image shows a canopy held by cherubs at the top center, flanked by symmetrical staircases with pillars and statues. The lower half includes a diagram of the altar platform with measurements and design plan. Various decorative motifs surround an inscription at the base, including a winged skull and hourglass. The drawing combines artistic and architectural elements with precision.

artworks.title: Kirchen Cermonien und Krönung des Zweigen Königs Christiani der Vierden... (Church Ceremonies and Coronation of the Eternal King Christian IV in Copenhagen on August 29, 1596
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a coronation ceremony with a grand procession and a crowd gathered to witness the event. The drawing depicts an intricate scene with a large number of figures and ornate architectural elements. In the foreground, there are figures on horseback and foot soldiers, suggesting a formal parade or procession. The central area is focused on an elaborate carriage or platform flanked by guards in armor. To the left, a scene with smoke or flames appears. The background is framed by large stone buildings with arches and crowds of observers. The detailed etching style and careful attention to clothing and architecture suggest a focus on historical accuracy and narrative detail.

artworks.title: Composite Image Depicting Actions of Henri IV, King of France, upon His Abjuration of the Protestant Faith
artworks.dimensions: sheet: 22 × 27.1 cm (8 11/16 × 10 11/16 in.) trimmed within plate mark
artworks.description: This is an engraving of an event inside a cathedral, with chaos depicted outside. The central focus is on the church's interior with columns and an altar. Inside, a gathering takes place, possibly a religious or ceremonial function. The architecture is gothic with arches and detailing. On the sides, scenes show conflict and chaos. The left side shows a skirmish or battle, with individuals in combat, and the right side shows fiery chaos. The engraving includes text.

artworks.title: Krönung von Eleonora von Gonzaga, Gemahlin Kaiser Ferdinands III., zur Römisch-Deutschen Kaiserin ; Ansicht von Regensburg (Coronation of Eleonora von Gonzaga, wife of Emperor Ferdinand II, as Empress, with a View of Regensburg)
artworks.description: The image consists of two parts. The top section shows a royal ceremony inside an ornate hall with Gothic architectural elements. A large crowd is gathered in formal attire. The lower section is a detailed cityscape, likely depicting Regensburg, featuring buildings and open fields.

artworks.title: Catafalque for the Funeral of the Duke of Parma Antonio I in the Church of S. Maria Maddalena in Bologna
artworks.dimensions: sheet: 49.8 × 37.5 cm (19 5/8 × 14 3/4 in.) trimmed within plate mark
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an ornate architectural interior with an elaborate altar. The scene features a grand hall with vaulted ceilings, patterns, curtains, and an altar with carvings, statues, and decorative elements. Sculptural figures flank the altar. Tall windows and chandeliers are in the background and along the hall's aisles. The drawing shows intricate designs and textures in fine line work.

artworks.title: Church Interior
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an interior architectural space. The drawing shows a grand interior, possibly a cathedral or large church, with high vaulted ceilings, large pillars, intricate decorations, relief sculptures, ornate designs, fresco paintings, ornate ironwork fencing, an elevated area with steps, religious depictions on the walls, and a pipe organ structure. The perspective adds depth to emphasize the Baroque-style architectural elements.
